            "text": "const Git4DScene: React.FC&lt;Git4DSceneProps&gt; = ({ mode, isPlaying, handTrackingEnabled }) =&gt; {",

            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (mode === 'vr' || mode === 'ar') {",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x000000);",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",

          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a0a);",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Add lighting",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, mode === 'ar' ? 0.8 : 0.4);",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "    scene.add(ambientLight);",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "    const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, mode === 'ar' ? 1.0 : 0.8);",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "    directionalLight.position.set(10, 10, 5);",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "    directionalLight.castShadow = mode === 'desktop';",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },

            "text": "    float fov = 3.14159f / 4.0f; // 45 degrees",
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "text": "    float tan_half_fov = tanf(fov / 2.0f);",

          },

            "lineNumber": 372
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Convert to pixel coordinates",
            "lineNumber": 373
          },

            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "        int pixel_y = (int)((1.0f - screen_y) * 0.5f * (float)height);",

          },

            "text": "        // Check bounds",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },

            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "            // Convert RGBA to BGRA and pack into u32",

          },

            "lineNumber": 381
          },

            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "            unsigned int color = (a &lt;&lt; 24) | (r &lt;&lt; 16) | (g &lt;&lt; 8) | b;",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "text": "            framebuffer[pixel_y * width + pixel_x] = color;",
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",

          },
          {
            "text": "    }",

          },

            "lineNumber": 389
          },

            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "The front-end expects the backend at &#96;http://localhost:8787&#96; by default.",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Set &#96;VITE_API_URL&#96; when running &#96;pnpm dev&#96; if you customize the port.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "## API",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;GET /api/actions&#96; – Fetches metadata about the available orchestration playbooks.",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;POST /api/actions/{id}/execute&#96; – Runs the selected playbook. The request body must include a",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;values&#96; object with form field values. The response contains stdout, stderr, exit code, and timing data",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  from the underlying CLI invocation.",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "The service shells out to the Codex CLI (&#96;codex&#96; by default). Use &#96;CODEX_GUI_CLI_PATH&#96; to point to a",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "specific executable if it is not on the &#96;PATH&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 33
          }
        ]
      },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "│                       External Services Layer                            │",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌────────────┐ │",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "│  │ OpenAI API   │  │  Anthropic   │  │  Web Search  │  │ MCP Tools  │ │",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "│  │ (GPT-4/5)    │  │  (Claude)    │  │ (DuckDuckGo) │  │ (Custom)   │ │",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └────────────┘ │",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "### Web GUI | コントロールセンター",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-gui&#96;（Rust/Axum）を追加し、Codex CLI の主要サブコマンドを HTTP API として公開。",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;gui/frontend&#96;（Node.js/Vite + React）で操作パネルを提供し、Playbook（Ask/Delegate/Research/Review/Audit）をワンクリック実行。",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "- 実行ログ（stdout/stderr/exit code/実行時間）をリアルタイムで可視化し、履歴パネルにスタック。",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;.env&#96;不要で、&#96;CODEX_GUI_CLI_PATH&#96; と &#96;VITE_API_URL&#96; により CLI パス/ポートを柔軟に切り替え可能。",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "- セキュアな CORS 設定と &#96;POST /api/actions/:id/execute&#96; での必須フィールド検証により、GUI からの誤操作を防止。",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "### Auto-Orchestration Flow | 自律オーケストレーションフロー",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "│                          User Input                                      │",
            "lineNumber": 81
          }
        ]
      },

          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## Running locally",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "# 1. Start the HTTP service",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "cd codex-rs",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo run -p codex-gui",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "# Optional: override settings",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "# CODEX_GUI_PORT=8080 CODEX_GUI_CLI_PATH=./target/debug/codex cargo run -p codex-gui",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "# 2. Start the front-end",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "cd ../gui/frontend",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "pnpm install",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "pnpm dev",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "The front-end expects the backend at &#96;http://localhost:8787&#96; by default.",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Set &#96;VITE_API_URL&#96; when running &#96;pnpm dev&#96; if you customize the port.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "## API",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;GET /api/actions&#96; – Fetches metadata about the available orchestration playbooks.",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;POST /api/actions/{id}/execute&#96; – Runs the selected playbook. The request body must include a",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;values&#96; object with form field values. The response contains stdout, stderr, exit code, and timing data",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  from the underlying CLI invocation.",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "The service shells out to the Codex CLI (&#96;codex&#96; by default). Use &#96;CODEX_GUI_CLI_PATH&#96; to point to a",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "specific executable if it is not on the &#96;PATH&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 33
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5030182600021362

## 実装完了サマリー

全8フェーズを実装しました：

1. **Phase 1**: スラッシュコマンド定義の追加（`/git4d`, `/vr`, `/ar`）
2. **Phase 2**: コマンドハンドラーの実装
3. **Phase 3**: coworkGUI統合の拡張
4. **Phase 4**: GUI側APIエンドポイントの追加
5. **Phase 5**: GUI側コンポーネント統合
6. **Phase 6**: Rust側Git4D機能との統合
7. **Phase 7**: エラーハンドリングとユーザーフィードバック
8. **Phase 8**: テストと検証

## 主な実装内容

- **スラッシュコマンド**: `/git4d`, `/vr`, `/ar`を追加
- **TUI → GUI統合**: cowork統合経由でGUI APIを呼び出し
- **APIエンドポイント**: `POST /api/visualization/git4d`を実装
- **Reactコンポーネント**: モードパラメータ対応とAPI呼び出し
- **エラーハンドリング**: リポジトリ未検出、GUI未起動、VR/ARデバイス未検出に対応
- **ユーザーフィードバック**: 起動中メッセージ、エラーメッセージ、成功通知

      "codeBlock": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# VR/AR/VRChat Integration Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 2.0.0  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**Last Updated**: 2025-11-06",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex provides VR/AR runtime abstraction and VRChat world optimization tools for immersive development experiences.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "### Features",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ OpenXR runtime abstraction",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Quest/Vive/Index device support",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Virtual Desktop optimization",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ VRChat world optimization tools",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Udon 2 support",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "## VR Runtime",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supported Devices",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "| Device | Status | Features |",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "|--------|--------|----------|",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "| Meta Quest | ✅ | WebXR, Hand tracking |",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "| Meta Quest 2 | ✅ | 90Hz, Passthrough |",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "| Meta Quest 3 | ✅ | 120Hz, Enhanced passthrough |",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "| HTC Vive | ✅ | SteamVR |",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "| HTC Vive Pro | ✅ | Enhanced tracking |",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "| Valve Index | ✅ | 144Hz, Finger tracking |",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "### Installation",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Install OpenXR SDK** (required for native VR support)",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Download from: https://www.khronos.org/openxr/",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Or use package manager:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Windows: choco install openxr",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "   # Linux: apt-get install libopenxr-dev",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Enable OpenXR Feature**",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "   cargo build --features openxr",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Verify VR Detection**",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "   codex --check-vr",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "## Virtual Desktop Optimization",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### Features",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Low latency streaming",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Bandwidth monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Quality adjustment",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Network optimization",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "### Usage",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "# Optimize for Virtual Desktop",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --optimize-virtual-desktop",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "# Monitor bandwidth",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --monitor-vr-bandwidth",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "### Quality Settings",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "| Quality | Resolution | Bitrate | Latency |",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "|---------|-----------|---------|---------|",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "| Low | 1080p | 50 Mbps | &lt;30ms |",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "| Medium | 1440p | 100 Mbps | &lt;25ms |",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "| High | 2160p | 150 Mbps | &lt;20ms |",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "| Ultra | 4K | 200 Mbps | &lt;15ms |",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## VRChat World Optimization",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "### Optimization Tools",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex provides tools for optimizing VRChat worlds:",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Material Atlas",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "Combines multiple textures into a single atlas to reduce draw calls:",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "codex vrchat-optimize --material-atlas world_path",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 99
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4517420530319214
    },

            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## 方針（今回の回答に基づく）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **統合方式**: &#96;merge&#96;（&#96;upstream/main&#96; を取り込むマージコミット）",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **作業場所**: **作業ブランチ**で統合作業 → 最後に &#96;main&#96; へ反映",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **独自機能の扱い**: ",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream に **同等機能が入っている**: upstream 実装へ寄せ、独自差分は削除/縮小",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream に **同等機能が無い**: 独自実装を維持しつつ、upstream の設計に合わせて最小差分で乗せ直す",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "## 事前確認（安全策）",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- 作業ツリーが汚れている可能性があるので、まず現状を保全する",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git status&#96; で変更の有無を確認",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 未コミットがあれば、作業ブランチ作成前に &#96;git stash push&#96; か「WIPコミット」で退避",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1) upstream の最新を取り込む（作業ブランチ）",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; と &#96;git fetch origin&#96; で参照を最新化",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;main&#96; から作業ブランチ作成（例: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;）",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;upstream/main&#96; を &#96;merge --no-ff&#96; で取り込み",
            "lineNumber": 37
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.503308117389679

            "text": "## 📋 概要",

            "text": "3. 競合を適切に解決してビルド可能な状態を維持",

          },

現在のブランチをバックアップ\n2. &#96;git merge upstream/main&#96;を実行\n3. コンフリクト解決:\n   - 公式の変更を優先（コア機能、バグフィクス、セキュリティ修正）\n   - 独自機能は&#96;#[cfg(feature = \"custom-features\")]&#96;で保護\n   - 両立可能な場合は統合\n\n**保護対象**:\n- &#96;orchestration/&#96;ディレクトリ\n- &#96;agents/&#96;モジュール\n- &#96;plan/&#96;モジュール\n- &#96;qc/&#96;モジュール\n- &#96;cowork_integration&#96;, &#96;vr_ar_integration&#96;, &#96;llmops&#96;, &#96;git4d_accelerated&#96;など\n\n#### 3.4 マージ後の検証\n\n- ビルド確認: &#96;cargo build --features custom-features&#96;\n- 型チェック: &#96;cargo check --features custom-features&#96;\n- テスト実行:       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.cursor\\plans\\upstream_merge_reconcile_f8cf50b7.plan.md",
        "range": {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "name: upstream_merge_reconcile",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "overview: fork(origin/main)に公式(upstream/main)の新機能/脆弱性修正/バグ修正を取り込みつつ、独自機能は「公式に同等機能が入ったら置き換え、無ければ維持」の方針でマージコンフリクトを解消し、最後にcodex-tuiをビルド→上書きインストール→実機確認→実装ログを残す。",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "todos:",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: sync-upstream-merge",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: 作業ブランチで upstream/main を merge し、コンフリクトを解消する",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: completed",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: reconcile-custom-features",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: 独自機能を upstream 同等機能へ置換/維持に仕分けし、差分を最小化する",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: in_progress",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: build-install-test-tui",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: codex-tui を release でビルド→上書きインストール→入力/スラッシュコマンドを実機確認する",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: pending",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: write-impl-log",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: _docs/ に所定フォーマットで実装ログを残す",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: pending",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## 方針（今回の回答に基づく）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **統合方式**: &#96;merge&#96;（&#96;upstream/main&#96; を取り込むマージコミット）",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **作業場所**: **作業ブランチ**で統合作業 → 最後に &#96;main&#96; へ反映",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **独自機能の扱い**: ",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream に **同等機能が入っている**: upstream 実装へ寄せ、独自差分は削除/縮小",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream に **同等機能が無い**: 独自実装を維持しつつ、upstream の設計に合わせて最小差分で乗せ直す",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "## 事前確認（安全策）",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- 作業ツリーが汚れている可能性があるので、まず現状を保全する",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git status&#96; で変更の有無を確認",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 未コミットがあれば、作業ブランチ作成前に &#96;git stash push&#96; か「WIPコミット」で退避",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1) upstream の最新を取り込む（作業ブランチ）",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; と &#96;git fetch origin&#96; で参照を最新化",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;main&#96; から作業ブランチ作成（例: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;）",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;upstream/main&#96; を &#96;merge --no-ff&#96; で取り込み",
            "lineNumber": 37
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3427051305770874

          },

            "text": "//! Plan state machine",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Defines the finite state machine for Plan lifecycle management.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! State transitions are strictly controlled to ensure safety and proper approvals.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::DateTime;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::Utc;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Deserialize;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Serialize;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "use thiserror::Error;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Plan state machine states",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "#[serde(tag = \"status\", rename_all = \"snake_case\")]",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "pub enum PlanState {",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan is inactive/not started",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    Inactive,",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan is being drafted",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    Drafting,",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan is pending approval",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    Pending {",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Timestamp when moved to pending",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "        pending_since: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan has been approved for execution",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    Approved {",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Who approved it",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        approved_by: String,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When it was approved",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        approved_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan was rejected",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    Rejected {",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Reason for rejection",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        reason: String,",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Who rejected it",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        rejected_by: Option&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When it was rejected",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        rejected_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan was superseded by a new version",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    Superseded {",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// ID of the new Plan",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        new_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When it was superseded",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        superseded_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan is currently executing",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    Executing {",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Execution ID",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        execution_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When execution started",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        started_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan execution completed successfully",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },

          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリとの整合性管理ガイド",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-10-23  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI/codex公式リポジトリとの整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持  ",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**戦略**: Fork + Enhancement（フォーク＋拡張）モデル",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔄 整合性戦略",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Upstream同期ポリシー",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 定期同期",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "# 月1回: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "git merge upstream/main --strategy-option theirs",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 選択的マージ",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **✅ 取り込む**: バグ修正、セキュリティアップデート、コア機能改善",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **❌ 取り込まない**: zapabob独自機能と競合する変更",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. ブランチ戦略",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "├── feature/zapabob-* (独自機能開発)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "└── hotfix/* (緊急修正)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 独自性維持項目",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 🔌 Gemini CLI MCP統合",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリとの整合性管理ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-10-23  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI/codex公式リポジトリとの整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持  ",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**戦略**: Fork + Enhancement（フォーク＋拡張）モデル",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔄 整合性戦略",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Upstream同期ポリシー",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 定期同期",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "# 月1回: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "git merge upstream/main --strategy-option theirs",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 選択的マージ",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **✅ 取り込む**: バグ修正、セキュリティアップデート、コア機能改善",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **❌ 取り込まない**: zapabob独自機能と競合する変更",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. ブランチ戦略",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "main (zapabob独自 + 公式統合)",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "├── upstream-sync (公式リポジトリ同期用)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "├── feature/zapabob-* (独自機能開発)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "└── hotfix/* (緊急修正)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 独自性維持項目",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 🔌 Gemini CLI MCP統合",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- OAuth 2.0認証（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- Google Search Grounding統合",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- 自動フォールバック: gemini-2.5-pro → gemini-2.5-flash",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP（Model Context Protocol）サーバー実装",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 公式との差分",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "// zapabob独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "codex-rs/",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "├── gemini-cli-mcp-server/  // 独自: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── src/",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "│   │   └── main.rs",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── Cargo.toml",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "└── deep-research/           // 拡張: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── src/",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        ├── gemini_search_provider.rs  // 独自",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        └── web_search_provider.rs     // 拡張",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 🔔 Marisa音声通知システム",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- タスク完了時の音声通知",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Marisaキャラクター音声",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- Windows/macOS/Linux対応",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 統合ポイント",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "# config.toml",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "[hooks]",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "on_task_complete = \"powershell -File zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1\"",
            "lineNumber": 71
          }
        ]
      },

        "detailedLines": [

            "text": "## 📊 概要",

          },

          },

          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\2025-10-07_公式リポジトリ統合.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 66
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリ統合作業ログ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025年10月7日 23:25 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI公式Codexリポジトリとの統合を行い、独自機能を尊重しつつ最新版と連携",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "ローカルにダウンロードしたCodexプロジェクトを、公式GitHubリポジトリと統合し、独自機能を保護しつつ最新の更新を取り込める体制を構築したで！",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 実施した作業",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Git リポジトリの初期化",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git init",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- ローカルディレクトリをGitリポジトリとして初期化",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- 空のリポジトリから開始",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 公式リポジトリの追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add origin https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;upstream&#96;: 公式リポジトリへの参照",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;origin&#96;: 同じく公式リポジトリ（標準的な命名規則に従う）",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29

        "detailedLines": [

            "text": "# 公式リポジトリ統合作業ログ",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025年10月7日 23:25 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI公式Codexリポジトリとの統合を行い、独自機能を尊重しつつ最新版と連携",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "ローカルにダウンロードしたCodexプロジェクトを、公式GitHubリポジトリと統合し、独自機能を保護しつつ最新の更新を取り込める体制を構築したで！",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 実施した作業",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Git リポジトリの初期化",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git init",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- ローカルディレクトリをGitリポジトリとして初期化",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- 空のリポジトリから開始",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 公式リポジトリの追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add origin https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;upstream&#96;: 公式リポジトリへの参照",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;origin&#96;: 同じく公式リポジトリ（標準的な命名規則に従う）",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. 公式リポジトリの取得",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- 公式リポジトリから全ブランチとタグを取得",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- 300以上のブランチが存在することを確認",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- 最新のタグ: &#96;rust-v0.45.0&#96;, &#96;rust-v0.2.0-alpha.2&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. ローカル状態の保存",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "git add .",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "git commit -m \"Initial commit: Local Codex files\"",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- 1079ファイルをコミット",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- 177,647行の追加を記録",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- コミットハッシュ: &#96;ccfc74e0&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. 独自機能の保護",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "git checkout -b feature/local-custom-features",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "- 独自機能を保存する専用ブランチを作成",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリを含むローカルカスタマイズを保護",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 差分分析",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "### 主な違い",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "公式リポジトリ(&#96;upstream/main&#96;)との差分:",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "- **291ファイル**に変更あり",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "- **+7,253行** 追加",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- **-16,431行** 削除",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "### 独自機能",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "以下のローカル独自機能を確認:",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリ**",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 実装ログ管理システム",
            "lineNumber": 66
          }
        ]
      },

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add docstring to calculate_total()\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "**Execution**:",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Single agent reads function",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Generates docstring",

          },
          {
            "text": "3. Applies patch",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Runs linter",

          },
          {
            "text": "5. Done in ~30 seconds",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "## Orchestrated Mode (Default)",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### When to Use",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Multi-file features",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Full-stack changes (backend + frontend)",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Database migrations",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Security-sensitive code",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Test generation required",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan (approved)",

          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "Central Planner",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "    ├── Task DAG",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── Sub-Agent Assignments",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "        ↓",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "Parallel Execution",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Backend Agent    → API changes",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Frontend Agent   → UI updates",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Database Agent   → Schema migrations",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Security Agent   → Vulnerability review",

          },
          {
            "text": "└─ QA Agent         → Test generation",

          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "Integrator",

          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Collect patches",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "└─ Prepare PR",

          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",

          },
          {
            "text": "Done",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "**Task**: Migrate session auth to JWT",

          },

          },

          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\guides\\qc-optimizer-orchestration.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 24
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# QC Optimizer サブエージェント &amp; 実装ログ自動化ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "zapabob/codex の中央集権型 AI オーケストレーションおよび Git worktree 並列開発において、メインマージ直前の品質保証を一貫化するための運用仕様です。",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. QC Optimizer サブエージェントの役割",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "| 項目 | 内容 |",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "| --- | --- |",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "| エージェント名 | &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; |",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主目的 | 単体/ユニット/異常系/包括的テストを実施し、統計・QC 観点でコード品質とアーキテクチャを評価。量子/数理最適化の観点でリスクを最小化し、メインマージ判断を可視化する。 |",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主要アウトプット | 1) テストスイート実行結果、2) 問題点の可視化レポート、3) QC/統計/量子最適化の結論、4) &#96;_doc/*.md&#96; に残す実装ログ |",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主なツール | &#96;cargo&#96;, &#96;npm&#96;, &#96;just&#96;, &#96;git&#96;, &#96;scripts/create-implementation-log.js&#96;, Codex MCP ファイル/検索ツール |",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. オーケストレーション手順",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **タスク解析**: Plan/TaskAnalyzer が worktree 単位にタスクを分割し、複雑度 0.7 以上の案件は自動的に &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; を含む並列フローに昇格。",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **開発サブエージェントの作業**: executor/refactorer などがコード変更を行い、PR 前に &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; に制御を移譲。",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **テストマトリクス実行**:",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;cargo test -p &lt;crate&gt;&#96; / &#96;cargo test --all-features&#96;（必要に応じて）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;npm test&#96; / &#96;pnpm test&#96;（GUI, website, prism-web 等）",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;just fmt&#96;/&#96;just fix -p &lt;project&gt;&#96; による Lint 修復",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "   - シナリオ/異常系テスト、snapshot テスト",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **統計・量子最適化評価**:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 失敗率、カバレッジ、実行時間、リソース消費を統計的に評価。",
            "lineNumber": 24
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.43100476264953613
    },

          {
            "text": "# Orchestrator Agent Skill",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Intelligent multi-agent workflow orchestrator that coordinates specialized Codex skills for complex task execution. Implements official OpenAI Agents SDK patterns including guardrails, handoffs, and worker agents with MCP-centric architecture for seamless integration.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Capabilities",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Task Decomposition**: Complex tasks → dependency-aware subtasks with intelligent planning",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Multi-Agent Coordination**: Parallel execution with worker agent assignment and handoffs",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **MCP Integration**: Direct Codex skill invocation via Model Context Protocol",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quality Assurance**: Built-in guardrails for security, performance, and best practices",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Progress Tracking**: Real-time workflow monitoring with detailed reporting",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Error Recovery**: Intelligent retry mechanisms and alternative execution paths",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tools Required",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### MCP Tools",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_read_file&#96; - Reading project files and specifications",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_write_file&#96; - Generating workflow artifacts and reports",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_search_replace&#96; - Updating configuration and code",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_grep&#96; - Searching for patterns and dependencies",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_codebase_search&#96; - Understanding project structure",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;grep&#96; - Text pattern matching utilities",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;read_file&#96; - File access for workflow operations",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;write&#96; - Creating workflow outputs and logs",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### File System Access",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Read**: Full codebase access for analysis and planning",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Write**: Limited to &#96;./artifacts&#96;, &#96;./workflows&#96;, &#96;./reports&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### Network Access",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ws://localhost:3000/*&#96; - MCP server for Codex skill invocation",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;https://docs.rs/*&#96; - Rust documentation for technical analysis",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;https://developer.mozilla.org/*&#96; - Web standards reference",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### Shell Commands",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex mcp-server&#96; - Starting MCP server for skill access",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git&#96; - Version control operations for workflow management",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;python&#96; - Workflow script execution",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;find&#96; - File system traversal for project analysis",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "## Usage Examples",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "### Complex Feature Development",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $orchestrator \"Implement complete user authentication system with API endpoints, database models, and comprehensive testing\"",

          },

          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-supervisor\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 41
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Supervisor",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Official OpenAI Codex Agents SDK Supervisor** - MCP-Centric Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestrator",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "This is an independent package that provides advanced multi-agent orchestration capabilities for OpenAI Codex, implementing the official Agents SDK patterns including handoffs, guardrails, and worker agents.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex Supervisor extends OpenAI Codex with sophisticated multi-agent workflows while maintaining compatibility with the official Skills + MCP + Agents SDK architecture. It acts as an intelligent coordinator that delegates complex tasks to specialized Codex Skills via MCP.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "┌─────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "│   Supervisor    │────│   Codex MCP      │",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "│   Orchestrator  │    │   Server         │",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "│ (This Package)  │    └──────────────────┘",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "└─────────────────┘             │",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "         │                      │",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "         ├──────────────────────┤",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "         │                      │",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    ┌────▼────┐    ┌─────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    │  Skill  │    │   Skill     │",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    │ Worker A│    │  Worker B   │",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    └─────────┘    └─────────────┘",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "## Official Agents SDK Compliance",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "This supervisor implements all official OpenAI Agents SDK concepts:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔒 Guardrails",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Security Guardrail**: Prevents dangerous operations and validates inputs",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quality Guardrail**: Ensures code quality and testing requirements",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Custom Guardrails**: Extensible guardrail system for domain-specific rules",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🤝 Handoffs",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },

          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "### Supervisor Orchestrator (&#96;supervisor.py&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Task Decomposition**: Complex tasks → subtasks with dependencies",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Dependency Management**: Automatic task ordering and parallel execution",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Progress Monitoring**: Real-time status tracking and reporting",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Result Aggregation**: Comprehensive workflow reports",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### MCP Bridge (&#96;mcp_bridge.py&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Codex Integration**: WebSocket-based MCP communication",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Tool Execution**: Direct tool invocation through Codex",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Fallback Support**: Direct skill execution when MCP unavailable",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Error Handling**: Robust connection management and retries",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### Worker Skills (&#96;.codex/skills/&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Official Format**: SKILL.md + scripts/ + references/",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },

          },

          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "name: upstream_merge_reconcile",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "overview: fork(origin/main)に公式(upstream/main)の新機能/脆弱性修正/バグ修正を取り込みつつ、独自機能は「公式に同等機能が入ったら置き換え、無ければ維持」の方針でマージコンフリクトを解消し、最後にcodex-tuiをビルド→上書きインストール→実機確認→実装ログを残す。",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "todos:",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: sync-upstream-merge",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: 作業ブランチで upstream/main を merge し、コンフリクトを解消する",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: completed",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: reconcile-custom-features",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: 独自機能を upstream 同等機能へ置換/維持に仕分けし、差分を最小化する",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: in_progress",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: build-install-test-tui",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: codex-tui を release でビルド→上書きインストール→入力/スラッシュコマンドを実機確認する",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: pending",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  - id: write-impl-log",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: _docs/ に所定フォーマットで実装ログを残す",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    status: pending",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## 方針（今回の回答に基づく）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **統合方式**: &#96;merge&#96;（&#96;upstream/main&#96; を取り込むマージコミット）",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **作業場所**: **作業ブランチ**で統合作業 → 最後に &#96;main&#96; へ反映",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **独自機能の扱い**: ",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream に **同等機能が入っている**: upstream 実装へ寄せ、独自差分は削除/縮小",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream に **同等機能が無い**: 独自実装を維持しつつ、upstream の設計に合わせて最小差分で乗せ直す",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "## 事前確認（安全策）",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- 作業ツリーが汚れている可能性があるので、まず現状を保全する",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git status&#96; で変更の有無を確認",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 未コミットがあれば、作業ブランチ作成前に &#96;git stash push&#96; か「WIPコミット」で退避",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1) upstream の最新を取り込む（作業ブランチ）",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; と &#96;git fetch origin&#96; で参照を最新化",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;main&#96; から作業ブランチ作成（例: &#96;merge-upstream-2025-12-20&#96;）",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;upstream/main&#96; を &#96;merge --no-ff&#96; で取り込み",
            "lineNumber": 37
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3210633397102356

            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-11-21 16:36:56  ",

          {
            "text": "**ブランチ**: main  ",

          },
          {
            "text": "**計画**: Upstream Sync &amp; Merge Plan  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git fetch origin&#96; の後、&#96;git log main..origin/main&#96; と &#96;git diff --stat main origin/main&#96; で差分を把握し重点領域（&#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/tauri-gui/src-tauri/Cargo.toml&#96;, ならびに大量削除された &#96;.specstory/_docs&#96; 系履歴）を整理。",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git merge --no-ff -X ours origin/main&#96; を実行して upstream と同期（結果は Already up to date）。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;just fmt&#96; が Windows shell 未設定で失敗したため、代替として &#96;cargo fmt --all&#96; を直接実行し整形確認。",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cargo test -p codex-cli&#96; を走らせて CLI crate のビルド健全性をチェック（0テスト構成だがビルド/リンク成功）。  ",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## 詳細メモ",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Assess Divergence",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- ログ＆差分統計で upstream との差異が &#96;Cargo.toml&#96;（2 箇所）と &#96;.specstory&#96; / &#96;_docs&#96; 系大量削除に集中していることを確認。",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- GUI/TUI/CLI の観点で今回差分は Cargo メタデータのみだったため、追加コンフリクトは無しと判断。",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "**実装状況**: [実装済み]  ",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**動作確認**: [未確認]  ",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "**確認日時**: 2025-11-21  ",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "**備考**: &#96;git log origin/main..main&#96; でローカルが3コミット先行していることも確認済み。",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Merge origin/main into main",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git merge --no-ff -X ours origin/main&#96; を実行。既に fast-forward 状態であったため新規コミットなし。",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git status -sb&#96; でマージ後も既存の &#96;.specstory&#96; / &#96;_docs&#96; 変更のみが残っていることを再確認。",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "**実装状況**: [実装済み]  ",

          },
          {
            "text": "**動作確認**: [未確認]  ",

            "text": "**備考**: upstream との乖離ゼロのため reapply 作業不要。",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Stabilize Workspace",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;just fmt&#96; が shell 検出エラーで停止したため、&#96;cargo fmt --all&#96; を直接実行（nightly 限定オプション警告のみで終了）。",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\release-package\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 156
          },
